a: Ha rabbi yishmael, ha rabbanan.
Veibbaet ema: ha veha bekodshe kadashim; umay bishne mekomot – kodem sheyyaamidu leviyyim et hammishkan,
b: Uleachar sheyyefarku haleviyyim et hammishkan.
Mahu detema: ippesil lehu beyotze; ka mashma lan.
Veema hachi name! amar kera: "venasa ohel moed" – af al pi shennasa, ohel moed hu.

Amar rav huna amar rav: mizbeach shel shilo – shel avanim haya. detanya, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: ma talmud lomar "avanim" "avanim" "avanim" shalosh peamim? echad shel shilo, veechad shel nov vegivon, uvet olamim.

Metiv rav acha bar amme: esh sheyyarda min hashshamayim bime moshe – lo nistalleka meal mizbach hannechoshet ella bime shelomo, veesh sheyyarda bime shelomo – lo nistalleka ad shebba menashshe vesillekah. veim ita, meikkara hu deistallak leh!
Hu deamar – kerabbi natan; detanya, rabbi natan omer: mizbeach shel shilo – shel nechoshet haya, chalul umale avanim.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: may lo nistalleka – lo nistalleka levattala. may hi? rabbanan amri: sheviva hava meshaddera. rav pappa amar: ushepiza hava naket, vezimnin hacha vezimnin hacha.
Tenan hatam: ucheshealu bene haggola – hosifu alav arba ammot min haddarom vearba ammot min hammaarav, kemin gamma. may tama? amar rav yosef: mishshum dela safak.

Amar leh abbaye: hasheta mikdash rishon, dichtiv beh: "yehuda veyisrael rabbim kachol asher al sefat hayyam" – sefek; mikdash sheni, dichtiv beh: "kol hakkahal keechad arba ribbo" – lo safek?! amar leh: hatam esh shel shamayim mesayyaytan, hacha en esh shel shamayim mesayyaytan.
Ki ata ravin, amar rabbi shimon ben pazzi mishshum bar kappara: shitin hosifu. meikkara sevur: "mizbach adama" – shehu atum baadama.
Ulevassof sevur: shetiyya kaachila, umay "mizbach adama" – shehu mechubbar baadama; shello yivnennu lo al gabbe kippim

a: Velo al gabbe mechillot.
Amar rav yosef, lav hayeynu detanya: "vayyachinu et hammizbeach al mechonato" – shehiggiu lesof middotav? vehachtiv: "hakkol bichtav miyyad Adonai alay hiskil"!
Ella amar rav yosef: kera ashkach uderash – "vayyomer david: ze hu bet Adonai haelohim, veze mizbeach leola leyisrael" – ki bayit; ma bayit shishshim amma, af mizbeach shishshim amma.
Bishlama bayit – minnachra tzurato; ella mizbeach – mena yadi?

Amar rabbi elazar: rau mizbeach banuy, umichael hassar haggadol omed umakriv alav. verabbi yitzchak nappacha amar: efro shel yitzchak rau, shemmunnach beoto makom. verabbi shemuel bar nachmani amar: mikkol habbayit kullo herichu reach ketoret, mishsham herichu reach evarim.

Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: shelosha neviim alu immahem min haggola – echad sheheid lahem al hammizbeach, veechad sheheid lahem al mekom hammizbeach, veechad sheheid lahem shemmakrivin af al pi sheen bayit.

Bematnita tana, rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: shelosha neviim alu immahen min haggola – echad sheheid lahem al hammizbeach veal mekom hammizbeach, veechad sheheid lahem shemmakrivin af al pi sheen bayit, veechad sheheid lahem al hattora – shettikkatev ashshurit.

Tanu rabbanan: keren vechevesh visod veribbua – meakkevin. middat orko umiddat rochbo umiddat komato – en meakkevin. mena hane mille? amar rav huna, amar kera: "hammizbeach"; kol makom shenneemar "hammizbeach" – leakkev.

Ella meatta, kiyyor lerabbi vesovev lerabbi yose berabbi yehuda – hachi name dimakkev?! dichtiv: "venatatta otah tachat karkov hammizbeach millematta", vetanya: ezehu karkov? rabbi omer: ze kiyyur, rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: ze hassovev!

In; detanya: oto hayyom nifgema keren mizbeach, veheviu bul shel melach usetamuhu; velo mippene shekkasher laavoda, ella shello yerae mizbeach pagum. shekkol mizbeach sheen lo keren vechevesh visod veribbua – pasul. rabbi yose berabbi yehuda omer: af hassovev.
Tanu rabbanan: ezehu karkov? ben keren lekeren, mekom hilluch ragle hakkohanim amma. attu (hakkohanim) [kohanim] ben keren lekeren havo azli?! ella ema: umekom hilluch ragle hakkohanim – amma.
Vehachtiv: "tachat karkubbo millematta ad chetzyo"! amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: tere havo; chad lenoy, vechad lechohanim dela nishtarku.

Middat orko umiddat rochbo umiddat komato – en meakkevin. amar rabbi mani: uvilvad shello yifchatennu mimmizbeach sheasa moshe. vechamma? amar rav yosef: amma. machachu aleh: "chamesh ammot orech vechamesh ammot rochav ravua yihye hammizbeach"!
Amar leh abbaye: dilma mekom maaracha kaamar mar? amar leh: mar degavra rabba hu, yada may kaamena. kare alayyhu
b: "Bene ketura". bene achateh derabbi tarfon havu yatvi kammeh derabbi tarfon, patach veamar: "vayyosef avraham vayyikkach ishsha ushemah yochani". amri leh: "ketura" ketiv! kare (alehem) [alayhu] "bene ketura".
Amar abbaye bar huna amar rav chama bar gureya: gezirin sheasa moshe – orkan amma, verochban amma, veovyayn kemachak godesh sea.
Amar rabbi yirmeya: beamma geduma. amar rav yosef, velav hayeynu detanya: "al haetzim asher al haesh asher al hammizbeach" – shello yehu etzim yotzin min hammizbeach kelum?!

Tenan hatam: kevesh haya lidromah shel mizbeach – orech sheloshim ushetayim, al rochav shesh esre. mena hane mille? amar rav huna, amar kera: "veshachat oto al yerech hammizbeach tzafona" – sheyyehe yarech betzafon, ufanav baddarom.
Ema: yarech batztzafon ufanav batztzafon! amar rava: rame gavra aappeh. amar leh abbaye: adderabba – taretz veotev gavra!
Amar leh: "ravua" ketiv. veha mibbee leh dimrabba rabboe! mi ketiv "merubba"?! velitamaych, mi ketiv "ravutz"?! amar leh: "ravua" ketiv – demashma hachi umashma hachi.
Vetanna mayyte la mehacha – detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: "umaalotehu penot kadim" – kol pinnot sheatta pone, lo yehu ella derech yamin lammizrach.

Veema semol lammizrach! la salka datach; detane rame bar (yechizkiyya) [yechezkel]: yam sheasa shelomo – "omed al shenem asar bakar; shelosha fonim tzafona, ushelosha fonim yamma, ushelosha ponim negba, ushelosha ponim mizracha" – kol pinnot sheatta pone, lo yehu ella derech yamin lammizrach.
Hahu mibbee leh legufeh! im ken, "ponim" "ponim" lema li?

Shaal rabbi shimon ben yose ben lakonya et rabbi yose: omer haya rabbi shimon ben yochay, avir yesh ben kevesh lammizbeach? amar lo: veatta – i atta omer ken?! vahalo kevar neemar: "veasita olotecha habbasar vehaddam" – ma dam bizrika, af basar bizrika!
Amar lo: sheani omer, omed betzad maaracha – vezorek.
Amar lo: keshehu zorek – lemaaracha deluka hu zorek, o lemaaracha sheenah deluka hu zorek? heve omer: lemaaracha deluka hu zorek! hatam mishshum dela efshar.
Rav pappa amar: ki dam; ma dam – avir karka mafsiko, af basar – avir karka mafsiko.
Amar rav yehuda: shene kevashim ketannim yotzin min hakkevesh, shebbahen ponim laysod velassovev; umuvedalin min hammizbeach melo nima, mishshum shenneemar "saviv". verabbi avahu amar: "ravua".

Veitzterich lemichtav "saviv", veitzterich lemichtav "ravua". dei ketav rachamana "saviv" – hava amena deagel migal; ketav rachamana "ravua". vei ketav rachamana "ravua" – hava amena daarich vekattin; ketav rachamana "saviv".
Tenan hatam: hakkevesh vehammizbeach – shishshim ushetayim. hane shittin vearbea havu! nimtza poreach amma al yesod veamma al sovev.

a: Amar rame bar chama: kol kivshe kevashim – shalosh ammot leamma, chutz mikkivsho shel mizbeach – shehaya shalosh ammot umechetza veetzba ushelish etzba bezachruta.
Mishna menachot hayu nikmatzot bechol makom baazara, veneechalot lifnim min hakkelaim – lezichre chehunna, bechol maachol, leyom valayla ad chatzot.
Gemara amar rabbi elazar: mincha shennikmetza bahechol – keshera, shekken matzinu besilluk bazichin.
Metiv rabbi yirmeya: "vekamatz mishsham" – mimmakom sheragle hazzar omdot.
Ben betira omer: minnayin sheim kamatz bismol – sheyyachazir veyikmotz beyamin? talmud lomar: "mishsham" – mimmakom shekkamatz kevar.
Ikka deamri: hu motev la vehu mefarek la; ikka deamri: amar leh rabbi akiva lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa, asbera lach: lo nitzrecha ella lehacheshir kol haazara kullah.
Salka datach amena: hoil veola kodshe kadashim, umincha kodshe kadashim; ma ola teuna tzafon, af mincha teuna tzafon.
Ma leola, shekken kalil!
Mechattat. ma lechattat, shekken mechapperet al chayyayve charetot!
Measham. ma leasham, shekken mine damim!
Mikkullehu. ma lechullehu, shekken mine damim!
Ella itzterich; salka datach amena, hoil uchetiv: "vehiggishah el hammizbeach", "veherim mimmennu bekumtzo" –
Ma haggasha bekeren maaravit deromit, af kemitza bekeren maaravit deromit; ka mashma lan.
Amar rabbi yochanan: shelamim sheshshechatan bahechol – kesherim, shenneemar: "ushechato (oto) petach ohel moed" – velo yehe tafel chamur min haikkar.
Metivi: rabbi yochanan ben betira omer, minnayin sheim hikkifu goyim et kol haazara – shehakkohanim nichnasin lesham veochlin sham kodshe kadashim? talmud lomar: "bekodesh hakkodashim tochlennu".
Veammay? nema: "bechatzer ohel moed yochluha" – velo yehe tafel chamur min haikkar!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam avoda – deadam oved bimkom rabbo, amrinan: lo yehe tafel chamur min haikkar. achila – deen adam ochel bimkom rabbo, lo yehe tafel chamur min haikkar – la amrinan.

Mishna chattat haof hayta naaset al keren deromit maaravit; uvechol makom hayta keshera, ella ze hayta mekomah. ushelosha devarim hayta otah keren meshammeshet millematta, ushelosha millemala. millematta: chattat haof, vehaggashot, usheyare haddam.
Umillemalan: nissuch hayyayin, vehammayim, veolat haof keshehi rabba bammizrach.
Kol haolin lammizbeach – olin derech yamin,
b: Umakkifin veyordin derech semol; chutz min haole lishlosha ellu – shehayu olin veyordin al heakev.
Gemara mena hane mille? amar rabbi yehoshua, amar kera: "lo yasim aleha shemen velo yitten aleha levona ki chattat hi" – chattat keruya mincha, umincha keruya chattat;
Ma chattat teuna tzafon – af mincha teuna tzafon, uma mincha bekeren maaravit deromit – af chattat bekeren maaravit deromit.
Umincha gufa menalan? detanya: "lifne Adonai" – yachol bammaarav? talmud lomar: "el pene hammizbeach".
I "el pene hammizbeach" – yachol baddarom? talmud lomar: "lifne Adonai". ha ketzad? maggishah bekeren maaravit deromit keneged chuddah shel keren, vedayyo.

Rabbi eliezer omer: yachol yaggishenna lemaaravah shel keren o lidromah shel keren? amarta: kol makom sheatta motze shene mikraot, echad mekayyem atzmo umekayyem chavero, veechad mekayyem atzmo umevattel chavero – mannichin ze shemmekayyem atzmo umevattel chavero, vetofsin et shemmekayyem atzmo umekayyem chavero.
Kesheatta omer "el pene Adonai" bammaarav, hechan kiyyaymta "el pene hammizbeach"? uchesheatta omer "el pene hammizbeach" baddarom, kiyyaymta "lifne Adonai".
Baddarom hechan kiyyaymta? amar rav ashe: kasavar hay tanna, kulleh mizbeach batztzafon kae.
Bechol makom hayta keshera [vechulei]. may kaamar? amar rav ashe, hachi kaamar: bechol makom hayta keshera limlikatah, ella ze haya mekomah lehazzaatah.

Tenena leha detanu rabbanan: melakah bechol makom bammizbeach – keshera. hizza damah bechol makom – keshera, hizza velo mitztza – keshera; uvilvad sheyyitten michut hassikra ulematta middam hannefesh.
May kaamar? hachi kaamar: melakah bechol makom bammizbeach – keshera. mitztza damah bechol makom bammizbeach – keshera,

a: Sheim hizza velo mitztza – keshera; uvilvad sheyyitten michut hassikra ulematta middam hannefesh.
Shelosha devarim kulei. chattat haof – ha daamaran.
Haggashot – dichtiv: "vehiggishah el pene hammizbeach". sheyare haddam – dichtiv: "veet kol dam happar yishpoch el yesod hammizbeach".
Millemala: nissuch hammayim, vehayyayin, veolat haof keshehi rabba bammizrach. may tama? rabbi yochanan amar: mippene shekkerova mibbet haddeshen.
Amar rabbi yochanan: bo uree kamma gadol kochan shel kohanim – sheen lach kal baofot yoter mimmurea venotza, peamim shehakkohen zorkan yoter mishsheloshim amma.

Ditnan: natal machta shel kesef, veala lerosh hammizbeach, ufinna et haggechalim elach veelach, vechata min hameukkalot happenimiyyot, veyored. higgia laritzpa – machazir panav kelappe tzafon, veholech lemizracho shel kevesh keeser ammot. tzavar et haggechalim al gabbe haritzpa rachok min hakkevesh shelosha tefachim – makom shennotnin murea venotza, vedishshun mizbeach happenimi vehammenora.
Hane tefe mittelatin vechad havyayn! mekom gavre la chashev.
Kol haolim lemizbeach, may tama? amar rabbi yochanan: nesachim – shemma yitashshenu, veolat haof – shemma tamut beashan.
Ureminhu: ba lo lehakkif et hammizbeach, meayin hu matchil? mikkeren deromit mizrachit, mizrachit tzefonit, tzefonit maaravit, maaravit deromit; venotnin lo yayin lenassech!
Amar rabbi yochanan:
b: Hakkafa baregel. amar rava: dayka name, dekatane "notnin lo yayin lenassech", vela katane "omer lo nassech"; shema minna.

Tanu rabbanan: kol haolin lemizbeach – olin derech yamin veyordin derech semol, olin derech mizrach veyordin derech maarav; chutz min haole lishlosha devarim hallalu – sheolim derech maarav veyordin derech maarav, olin derech yamin veyordin derech yamin.
"Derech yamin"?! derech semol hu! amar ravina: teni "semol". rava amar: may "yamin" – yamin demizbeach, umay "semol" – semol degavra.
Venitne o idde veidde demizbeach, o idde veidde degavra! kashya.

Mishna chattat haof ketzad haya naaset? (ala lakkevesh ufana lassovev ba lo lekeren deromit mizrachit), haya molek et roshah mimmul orpa veeno mavdil, umazze middamah al kir hammizbeach. sheyare haddam haya mitmatztze al hayesod; veen lemizbeach ella damah, vechullah lakkohanim.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: "vehizza middam hachattat" – migguf hachattat. ha ketzad? ochez barosh uvagguf, umazze al kir hammizbeach; velo al kir hakkevesh, velo al kir hechol, velo al kir ulam. veeze? ze kir hattachton.
O eno ella kir haelyon? vedin hu: uma behema, sheolatah lematta – chattatah lemala; of, sheolato lemala – eno din shechattato lemala?!
Talmud lomar: "vehannishar baddam yimmatze el yesod hammizbeach" – kir shehashsheyarin shello mitmatztzim laysod; veeze? ze kir hattachton.
Venabed meillay, vahadar nabed mittattay! amar rava: mi ketiv "yematztze"?! "yimmatze" ketiv, demimmela mashma.
Amar rav zutera bar toviyya amar rav: ketzad molkin chattat haof? ochez gappav bishte etzbaot ushete raglayim bishte etzbaot, umoteach tzavvarah al rochav gudalo, umolkah.
Bematnita tena: tzippera millevar; ochez gappav bishte etzbaot ushene raglayim bishte etzbaot, umoteach tzavvaro al rochav shete etzbeotav, umolek. vezo avoda kasha shebbammikdash.
Zo hi – vetu la?! vehaikka kemitza vachafina! ella ema: zo avoda kasha meavodot kashot shebbammikdash.

Mishna olat haof ketzad naaset? ala lakkevesh ufana lassovev, ba lo lekeren deromit mizrachit. haya molek et roshah mimmul orpa, umavdil, umitztza et damah al kir hammizbeach. natal et harosh vehikkif bet melikato lammizbeach, sefago bemelach, uzerako al gabbe haishshim.

Ba lo lagguf, vehesir et hammurea veet hannotza veet bene hammeayim hayyotzin immam, vehishlichan levet haddeshen. shissa, velo hivdil. veim hivdil – kasher. sofgo bemelach, vezorko al gabbe haishshim.

Lo hesir hammurea velo hannotza veet bene meayim hayyotzin immam, velo sefago bemelach – kol sheshshinna bah meacher shemmitztza et damah, keshera. hivdil bachattat velo hivdil baola – pasul. mitztza et dam harosh velo mitztza dam hagguf – pesula. dam hagguf velo mitztza dam harosh – keshera.
Chattat haof shemmelakah shello lishmah; mitztza damah shello lishmah; lishmah veshello lishmah; o shello lishmah velishmah – pasul. olat haof keshera, uvilvad shello alta livalim leshem chova.

Echad chattat haof veechad olat haof, shemmelakan veshemmitztza et daman – leechol davar sheddarko leechol, ulehaktir davar sheddarko lehaketir chutz limkomo; pasul veen bo karet. chutz lizmanno – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet; uvilvad sheyyakriv hammattir kemitzvato.

Ketzad karav hammattir kemitzvato? malak bishtika, umitztza haddam chutz lizmanno; o shemmalak chutz lizmanno, umitztza haddam bishtika; o shemmalak umitztza haddam chutz lizmanno – zehu shekkarav hammattir kemitzvato.
Ketzad lo karav hammattir kemitzvato? malak chutz limkomo, mitztza haddam chutz lizmanno; o shemmalak chutz lizmanno, umitztza haddam chutz limkomo; o shemmalak umitztza haddam chutz limkomo;

a: Chattat haof (shemmelako) [shemmelakah] shello lishmah, umitztza haddam chutz lizmanno; o shemmalak chutz lizmanno, umitztza damo shello lishmah; o shemmalak umitztza haddam shello lishmah – zehu shello karav hammattir kemitzvato.
Leechol kezayit bachutz kezayit lemachar, kezayit lemachar kezayit bachutz, kachatzi zayit bachutz kachatzi zayit lemachar, kachatzi zayit lemachar kachatzi zayit bachutz – pasul, veen bo karet.

Amar rabbi yehuda, ze hakkelal: im machshevet hazzeman kadma lemachshevet hammakom – piggul, vechayyayvin alav karet. veim machshevet hammakom kadma lemachshevet hazzeman – pasul, veen bo karet. [vachachamim omrim: ze vaze pasul veen bo karet.]
Leechol kachatzi zayit ulehaktir kachatzi zayit – kasher, sheen achila vehaketara mitztarfin.
Gemara tanu rabbanan: "vehikrivo" – ma talmud lomar?
Lefi shenneemar: "vehikriv min hattorim o min bene hayyona" – yachol hammitnaddev of lo yifchot mishshene peridin? talmud lomar: "vehikrivo" – afillu perida achat yavi el hammizbeach.

Ma talmud lomar: "hakkohen"? likboa lo kohen. sheyyachol vahalo din hu: uma ben tzon, shekkava lo tzafon – la kava lo kohen; of, shella kava lo tzafon – eno din shello yikba lo kohen?! talmud lomar: "(el) hakkohen" – likboa lo kohen.
Yachol yimlekennu besakkin? vedin hu: uma im shechita, shello kava lah kohen – kava lah keli; melika, shekkava lah kohen – eno din sheyyikba lah keli?!
Talmud lomar: "kohen... umalak". amar rabbi akiva: vechi taale al datecha shezzar karev legabbe mizbeach?! ella ma talmud lomar: "kohen"? shettehe melika beatzmo shel kohen.
Yachol yimlekenna ben millemala ben millematta? talmud lomar: "umalak... vehiktir" – ma haketara berosh hammizbeach, af melika berosh hammizbeach.
"Umalak" – mimmul oref. atta omer mimmul oref; o eno ella min hatztzavvar? vedin hu: neemar kan "umalak", veneemar lehallan "umalak"; ma lehallan mimmul oref, af kan mimmul oref!
I – ma lehallan molek veeno mavdil, af kan molek veeno mavdil?! talmud lomar: "umalak vehiktir"; ma haketara – harosh leatzmo vehagguf leatzmo, af melika – harosh leatzmo vehagguf leatzmo.
Uminnayin shehaketarat harosh beatzmo vehagguf beatzmo? shenneemar: "vehiktir oto" – hare haketarat hagguf amura; ha ma ani mekayyem "vehiktir hammizbecha"? behaketarat harosh hakkatuv medabber.
"Venimtza damo" – kullo. "al kir hammizbeach" – velo al kir hakkevesh, velo al kir hahechol; veeze ze? ze kir haelyon.
O eno ella kir hattachton? vedin hu: ma behema, shechattatah lemala – olatah lematta; of, shechattato lematta – eno din sheolato lematta?

Talmud lomar: "umalak... vehiktir... venimtza damo" – vechi taale al datecha leachar shehiktir chozer umematztze?! ella lomar lach: ma haketara berosh hammizbeach, af mitztzuy berosh hammizbeach. ha ketzad? haya ole bakkevesh ufone lassovev, uva lo lekeren deromit mizrachit; haya molek et roshah mimmul orpa umavdil, umematztze middamah al kir hammizbeach. im asaah lematta meraglav, afillu amma – keshera.
Rabbi nechemya verabbi eliezer ben yaakov omrim: kol atzmah en naaset ella berosh hammizbeach. may benayyhu?
Abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: ose maaracha al gabbe sovev ikka benayyhu.
Ba lo lagguf kulei. tanu rabbanan: "vehesir et murato benotzatah" – zo zefek.
Yachol yakdir besakkin veyittelennu? talmud lomar: "benotzatah" – notel et hannotza immah. abba yose ben chanan omer: notlah venotel kurekvanah immah.
Deve rabbi yishmael tana: "benotzatah" – benotza shellah; kodrah besakkin kemin arubba.
b: Shissa velo hivdil. tanu rabbanan: "veshissa" – en shissa ella bayyad, vechen hu omer: "vayshasseehu keshassa haggedi".
Lo hesir et hammurea kulei. matnitin dela kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon; detanya, amar rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: shamati shemmavdilin bechattat haof.
May benayyhu? amar rav chisda: mitztzuy chattat haof meakkev ikka benayyhu. tanna kamma savar: mitztzuy chattat haof meakkev; vechevan demitztzuy dam, kaaved maase ola bechattat haof.
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar: mitztzuy chattat haof lo meakkev, umechattech basar bealma hu.
Rava amar: shehiyyay besiman sheni beolat haof meakkev ikka benayyhu. tanna kamma savar: shehiyyay besiman sheni beolat haof – lo meakkev; veaf al gav dishhiyyay, ka aved maase ola bechattat.
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon savar: meakkev; vechevan dishhiyyay, mechattech basar bealma hu.
Abbaye amar: rov basar meakkev ikka benayyhu.
Uviflugeta derabbi zera verabbi shemuel bar rav yitzchak; chad amar: shehiyyay besiman sheni beolat haof meakkev ikka benayyhu, vechad amar: rov basar meakkev ikka benayyhu.

Mikkelal devaenan derov basar battechilla?! in; vehatanya: ketzad molkin chattat haof? chotech shidra umafreket belo rov basar, ad shemmaggia lavvevshet o lakkane. higgia lavvevshet o lakkane – chotech siman echad o rubbo, verov basar immo. uvaola – shenayim o rov shenayim.

Amruha kammeh derabbi yirmeya, amar: la shemia lehu ha deamar rabbi shimon ben elyakim mishshum rabbi elazar ben pedat mishshum rabbi elazar ben shammua? omer haya rabbi elazar berabbi shimon: shamati bechattat haof shemmavdilin. umay "lo yavdil" –

a: En tzarich lehavedil. amar leh rav acha bereh derava lerav ashe: ella meatta, gabbe vor dichtiv "velo yechassennu" – hachi name deen tzarich lechassot?!
Hachi hasheta?! hatam, kevan dichtiv "baal habbor yeshallem" – illaveh hu dirme lechassoye. aval hacha, mikkede ketiv "vehikrivo" – chalak hakkatuv ben chattat haof leolat haof;
"Lo yavdil" lema li? shema minna: en tzarich lehavedil.
Mitztza dam hagguf. tanu rabbanan: "ola" – af al pi shemmitztza dam hagguf velo mitztza dam harosh. yachol mitztza dam harosh velo mitztza dam hagguf? talmud lomar: "hu".
May talmuda? amar ravina: mistabbera, derov damim bagguf shechichi.
Hadaran alach kodshe kadashim
Mishna chattat haof sheasaah lematta, kemaase chattat, leshem chattat — keshera.
Kemaase chattat leshem ola, kemaase ola leshem chattat, kemaase ola leshem ola – pesula. asaah lemala kemaase kullan – pesula.
Olat haof sheasaah lemala; kemaase ola leshem ola – keshera. kemaase ola leshem chattat – keshera, uvilvad shello alta livaleha.
Kemaase chattat leshem ola, kemaase chattat leshem chattat – pesula. asaah lematta; kemaase kullan – pesula.
b: Gemara deshanni bemay? ilema deshanni bimlika – nema dela kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon, deamar: shamati shemmavdilin bechattat haof?
Vela okemna dela kerabbi elazar berabbi shimon?!
La; deshanni behazzaa.

Hachi name mistabbera – middekatane sefa: asaah lemala kemaase kullan – pesula, vaafillu kemaase chattat leshem chattat. deshanni bemay? ilema deshanni bimlika, haamar mar: melika bechol makom bammizbeach – keshera! ella lav deshanni behazzaa? umiddesefa behazzaa, resha name behazzaa.
Midde irya?! ha kidita, veha kidita!
Olat haof kulei. deshanni bemay?
Illema deshanni bimlika; middekatane sefa: kullan en metammein bevet habbelia, umoalin bahen – nema dela kerabbi yehoshua? dei kerabbi yehoshua, haamar: en moalin!
Veella bemitztzuy?
Ema sefa: olat haof sheasaah lematta kemaase chattat leshem chattat – rabbi eliezer omer: moalin bah, rabbi yehoshua omer: en moalin bah. deshanni bemay?
Illema bemitztzuy, emar deamar rabbi yehoshua – deshanni bimlika; bemitztzuy mi amar?!
Veella bimlika? resha vesefa bimlika, umetziata bemitztzuy?!
In; resha vesefa bimlika, umetziata bemitztzuy.
Mishna vechullan en metammein bevet habbelia, umoalim bahen; chutz mechattat haof sheasaah lematta kemaase chattat leshem chattat.
Olat haof sheasaah lematta kemaase chattat leshem chattat – rabbi eliezer omer: moalim bah, rabbi yehoshua omer: en moalim bah.
Amar rabbi eliezer: uma im chattat, sheen moalim bah lishmah – kesheshshinna et shemah moalim bah; ola, shemmoalim bah lishmah – kesheshshinna et shemah eno din sheyyimalu bah?!

Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: lo; im amarta bechattat sheshshinna et shemah leshem ola – shekken shinna et shemah ledavar sheyyesh bo meila; tomar beola sheshshinna et shemah leshem chattat – shekken shinna et shemah ledavar sheen bo meila?!

a: Amar lo rabbi eliezer: vahare kodshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom ushechatan leshem kodashim kallim yochichu – shekken shinna et shemam ledavar sheen bo meila, umoalin bahen; af atta al titma al haola – af al pi sheshshinna shemah ledavar sheen bo meila, sheyyimalu bah!

Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: lo; im amarta bekodshe kadashim sheshshechatan baddarom ushechatan leshem kodashim kallim – shekken shinna et shemam ledavar sheyyesh bo issur vehetter; tomar beola – sheshshinna et shemah ledavar shekkullo hetter?!

Gemara tanya, amar lo rabbi eliezer lerabbi yehoshua: asham sheshshechato batztzafon leshem shelamim yochiach – sheshshinna et shemo, umoalin bo; veaf atta al titma al haola – sheaf al pi sheshshinna et shemah, sheyyimalu bah.
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: lo; im amarta beasham – sheim shinna et shemo lo shinna et mekomo; tomar beola – sheshshinna et shemah veshinna et mekomah?!

Amar lo rabbi eliezer: asham sheshshechato baddarom leshem shelamim yochiach – sheshshinna et shemo veshinna et mekomo, umoalin bo; af atta al titma al haola – sheaf al pi sheshshinna et shemah veshinna et mekomah, moalin bah.
Amar lo rabbi yehoshua: lo; im amarta beasham – sheshshinna et shemo veshinna et mekomo, velo shinna et maasav; tomar beola – sheshshinna et shemah veet maaseha, veshinna et mekomah?!
Amar rava, venema leh: asham sheshshechato baddarom leshem shelamim beshinnuy bealim – sheshshinna et shemo, veshinna et mekomo, veshinna et maasav!

Middela kaamar leh hachi, shema minna: nechet rabbi eliezer letameh derabbi yehoshua – deamar rav adda bar ahava, omer haya rabbi yehoshua: olat haof sheasaah lematta kemaase chattat leshem chattat – kevan shemmalak bah siman echad, nimshechet venaaset chattat haof.

I hachi, chattat haof name – sheasaah lemala kemaase haola; mikki malek ba siman echad, timmashech veteheve olat haof! vechi tema hachi name, veha amar rabbi yochanan mishshum rabbi benaa: kach hi hatztzaa shel mishna! may, lav kach hi hatztzaa – vetu la?
La; kach hatztzaa shel kullah mishna.

Rav ashe amar: bishlama olat haof sheasaah lematta kemaase chattat leshem chattat – kevan deha hechsherah besiman echad veha hechsherah bishne simanin; veolat haof lematta leta; kevan demalak bah siman echad – nimshechet venaaset chattat haof.
Ella chattat haof, kevan deamar mar: melika – bechol makom keshera; mikki malek ba siman echad – ippasla; ki hadar malek beiddach siman – hechi mimmashcha vehavya olat haof?
Gufa – amar rav adda bar ahava, omer haya rabbi yehoshua: olat haof sheasaah lematta kemaase chattat leshem chattat – kevan shemmalak bah siman echad, nimshechet venaaset chattat haof.
b: Ta shema: chattat lazo veola lazo;

Asa shetehen lemala – mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. shetehen lematta – mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. achat lemala veachat lematta – shetehen pesulot; sheani omer: chattat kereva lemala, veola kereva lematta.
Nehi name deola kereva lematta, timshoch veteheve chattat haof!
Emor deamar rabbi yehoshua – bechad gavra; bitre gavre mi amar?!
Ta shema: chattat veola, usetuma, umeforeshet –
Asa kullan lemala – mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. kullan lematta – mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. chetzyayn lemala vechetzyayn lematta – enah keshera ella setuma, umitchalleket benehen.
Veillu meforashin – la; veammay? nehi name deola kereva lematta, timshoch vetihve chattat haof!
Vechi tema ha dela kerabbi yehoshua – umi matzet amrat hachi?!
Ta shema, haishsha sheamra: "hare alay ken im eled zachar"; yalda zachar – mevia shete kinnim, achat lenidrah veachat lechovatah.
Netanatan lakkohen – hakkohen tzarich laasotan shalosh lemala veachat lematta.
Lo asa ken, ella asa shetayim lemala ushetayim lematta, velo nimlach – tzericha shettavi od pereda achat, vetakrivenna lemala.
Mimmin echad. umishshene minin – tavi shetayim.
Persha nidrah – [tzericha] lehavi od shalosh peredin.
Mimmin echad. umishshene minin – tavi arba.
Kava nidrah –

a: Tzericha shettavi od chamesh peredin lemala.
Mimmin echad. umishshene minin – tavi shesh.
Netanatan lakkohen, veenah yodaat ma natna; halach hakkohen veasa, veeno yodea ma asa – tzericha arba peridin lenidrah, ushetayim lechovatah, vechattat achat.
Ben azzay omer: shete chattaot.
Amar rabbi yehoshua, zehu sheamru: keshehu chay – kolo echad, ucheshehu met – kolo shiva.
Emar daamar rabbi yehoshua – leappoka mide meila; lemissak leh lechova mi amar?!
Mishna kol happesulin shemmalku – melikatan pesula, veenan metammeot bevet habbelia. malak bismol o ballayla, shachat chullin bifnim vekadashim bachutz – enan metammeot bevet habbelia.
Malak besakkin; malak chullin bifnim vekadashim bachutz;
b: Torin shello higgia zemannan, uvene yona sheavar zemannan; sheyyavsha gappah, shennismet enah veshenniktea raglah – metamme bevet habbelia.
Ze hakkelal: kol sheppesulo bakkodesh – eno metamme bevet habbelia; lo haya pesulo bakkodesh – metamme bevet habbelia.
Gemara amar rav: semol velayla – en metammein bevet habbelia, zar vesakkin – metammein bevet habbelia.
May shena semol – deit leh hechshera beyom hakkippurim, velayla – it leh hechshera beevarim ufedarim; zar name – it leh hechshera bishchita! shechita lav avoda hi.
Vela?! veha amar rabbi zera: shechitat para bezar – pesula; umachve rav ala: elazar vechukka"!
Shane para, dekodshe bedek habbayit hi.
Vela kol dechen hu: kodshe bedek habbayit bau kehunna, kodshe mizbeach mibbaya?!
Amar rav shisha bereh derav idi: midde dehave ammarot negaim – delav avoda hi, uvaaya kehunna.
Venelaf mibbama!
Mibbama la yalef.
Vela?! vehatanya: minnayin layyotze sheim ala lo yered – shehare yotze kasher bevama.
Tana azzot torat haola" semich leh.
Verabbi yochanan amar: zar en metamme abbet habbelia, sakkin metamme abbet habbelia.
Tenan: kol happesulin shemmalku – melikatan pesula. bishlama lerabbi yochanan, "kol" – leetoye zar. ella lerav, "kol" – leetoye may?
(Lav) leetoye semol velayla. semol velayla behedya katane! tane vahadar mefaresh.
Ta shema: ze hakkelal – kol shehaya pesulo bakkodesh, eno metamme begadim abbet habbelia. bishlama lerabbi yochanan, "kol" leetoye zar. ella lerav, leetoye may?

a: Velitamaych, "shello haya pesulo bakkodesh" leetoye may?
Ella resha leetoye shechitat kadashim bifnim, sefa leetoye melikat chullin bachutz.
Tanya kevavteh derabbi yochanan: melakah zar, melakah pasul, happiggul vehannotar vehattame – en metammein abbet habbelia.
Amar rabbi yitzchak: shamati shetayim – achat kemitzat zar, veachat melikat zar; achat tered, veachat lo tered; vela yadana. amar chizkiyya, mistabbera: kemitza tered, melika lo tered.
May shena melika – deyeshnah bevama, kemitza name – yeshnah bevama!
Vechi tema en mincha bevama, en ofot name bevama!
Deamar rav sheshet: ledivre haomer yesh mincha bevama – yesh ofot bevama. ledivre haomer en mincha – en ofot. may tama? "zevachim" velo menachot, "zevachim" velo ofot.
Ella ema: en kiddush bichli sharet bemincha bevama.
Malak bismol o ballayla kulei. tanu rabbanan: yachol tehe melika shehi lifnim, metammea begadim bevet habbelia? talmud lomar: "nevela".
Ha name nevela hi! ella talmud lomar: "terefa"; ma terefa – sheen matteret et haissur, af kol – sheen matteret et haissur.
(Yatza) [yatzat] melika shehi lifnim – hoil vehi matteret et haissur, en metamme begadim bevet habbelia.
Hevi hammolek (ketz chafetz – siman) kadashim bachutz, umolek chullin ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz – hoil veen mattirin et haissur, metammein begadim abbet habbelia.
Tanya iddach: yachol tehe shechitat chullin lifnim, vekadashim ben mibbifnim uven mibbachutz, metammea abbet habbelia? talmud lomar: "nevela".
Ha name nevela hi! ella talmud lomar: "terefa"; ma terefa – shavav bifnim kevachutz, af kol – shavot bifnim kevachutz.
Yatza shechitat chullin bifnim, vekadashim ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz – hoil velo shavu bifnim kevachutz, en metammein begadim abbet habbelia.
Bishlama chullin – lo shavu bifnim kevachutz; ella kadashim – idde veidde pesulin ninhu!
Amar rava: im hoila lo shechitat chutz lechayyeyvo karet, lo toil lo letaharah mide nevela?!
Ashkechan chutz, panim menalan? hoil velo shavu bifnim kevachutz.
I hachi, malak kadashim bachutz name la – dela shavu bifnim kevachutz!
Amar rav shimi bar ashe: danin davar shello behechshero middavar shello behechshero; veen danin davar shello behechshero middavar shebbehechshero.
Vela?! vehatanya: minnayin leyotze – sheim ala lo yered? shehare yotze kasher bevama.
Tanna azzot torat haola" ribba semich leh.
Mishna malak venimtzet terefa – rabbi meir omer: enah metamme bevet habbelia,
b: Rabbi yehuda omer: metamme.

Amar rabbi meir: kal vachomer; im nivlat behema, shemmetammea bemagga uvemassa – shechitatah metaheret terefatah mittumeatah; nivlat haof, sheeno metamme bemagga uvemassa – eno din shettehe shechitato metaheret terefato mittumeato?!
Ma matzinu bishchitato – shehi machshartah laachila, umetaheret terefato mittumeato; af melikato, shehi machsharto baachila – tetaher terefato mide tumeato!
Rabbi yose omer: dayyah kenivlat behema – shechitatah metahartah, velo melikatah.
Gemara verabbi meir la daresh "dayyo"?! veha "dayyo" deorayyta hu!
Detanya: middin kal vechomer ketzad? "vayyomer Adonai el moshe: veaviha yarok yarak befaneha vegomer" – kal vechomer lashshechina arbaa asar yom; ella dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon.
Amar rabbi yose berabbi avin: rabbi meir kera ashkach vekadaresh –

"Zot torat habbehema vehaof" – vechi beezo tora shavvta behema leof veof livhema? behema metammea bemagga uvemassa, of eno metamme bemagga uvemassa! of metamme begadim abbet habbelia, behema enah metammea begadim abbet habbelia!
Ella lomar lach: ma behema – davar shemmachshirah laachila, metaher terefatah mittumeatah; af of – davar shemmachshiro baachila, metaher terefato mittumeato.

Verabbi yehuda may tama? kera ashkach vekadaresh: "nevela terefa". amar rabbi yehuda: terefa lamma neemra? im terefa chayya – hare nevela amura! im terefa enah chayya – hare hi bichlal nevela! ella lehavi terefa sheshshechatah, shemmetammea.
Amar leh rav shezvi: ella meatta, dichtiv: "vechelev nevela vechelev terefa" –
Hatam name nema: im terefa chayya – hare nevela amura, im terefa enah chayya – hare hi bichlal nevela! ella lehavi terefa sheshshechatah, shechelbah tahor. mikkelal dehi metammea?
Vehaamar rav yehuda amar rav, veamri la bematnita tana: "vechi yamut min habbehema" – miktzat behema metammea, miktzat behema enah metammea. veezo zo? zo terefa sheshshechatah!
Ella terefa mibbee leh – lemaote temea; mi sheyyesh beminah terefa, yatzta zo sheen beminah terefa.
Hacha name – lemaote of tame, sheen bemino terefa!
Of tame lerabbi yehuda – minnevela nafka leh.

Detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: yachol tehe nivlat of tame metammea begadim abbet habbelia? talmud lomar: "nevela uterefa lo yochal" – mi sheissuro mishshum bal tochal nevela; yatza ze, sheen issuro mishshum bal tochal nevela ella mishshum bal tochal tame.

a: Hay name tippok li mivvechelev nevela" –
Mi sheissuro mishshum bal tochal chelev nevela; yatzata zo sheen issurah mishshum bal tochal [chelev nevela], ella mishshum tame!
Ella hay terefa mibbee leetoye chayya – salka datach amena: mi shechelbah asur uvesarah muttar, yatzat zo shechelbah uvesarah muttar; ka mashma lan.
Amar leh: may shena temea – deen chelbah chaluk mibbesarah; chayya name – en chelbah chaluk mibbesarah! veod, hachtiv: "veachol lo tochluhu"!
Ella amar abbaye: terefa legufeh itzterich; shello tomar: hoil utemea asura mechayyim, uterefa asura mechayyim – ma temea chelbah tame, af terefa chelbah tame.
I hachi, hay name mibbee; shello tomar: hoil veof tame asur baachila, uterefa asura baachila – ma of tame eno metamme, af terefa enah metammea!
Veod, mi ikka lemelaf terefa mittemea?! temea lo hayta lah sheat hakkosher, terefa hayta lah sheat hakkosher! vechi tema: terefa mibbeten may ikka lememar? bemina miha ikka!
Ella amar rava, hattora amra: yavo issur nevela veyachul al issur chelev, yavo issur terefa veyachul al issur chelev.
Utzerichi; dei ashmeinan nevela – mishshum dimtammeya, aval terefa ema la; vei ashmeinan terefa – mishshum deissurah mechayyim, aval nevela ema la; tzericha.
Verabbi meir, hay "terefa" may aved leh? mibbee leh lemaote shechita shehi lifnim.
Verabbi yehuda – "terefa" acharina ketiv.
Verabbi meir – chad lemaote shechita shehi lifnim, vechad lemaote of tame.
Verabbi yehuda – minnevela" nafka leh.
Verabbi meir – hay "nevela" may aved le? leshiur achila bichzayit.
Vetippok li mikkera kamma, middeappekeh rachamana bilshon achila!
Chad leshiur achila bichzayit, vechad leshiur achila bichde achilat peras.
Salka datach amena: hoil vechiddush hu – yoter mikkede achilat peras name litamme; ka mashma lan.
Tanu rabbanan: "vechelev nevela vechelev terefa" – bechelev behema tehora hakkatuv medabber.
Atta omer bechelev behema tehora hakkatuv medabber; o eno ella bechelev behema temea?
Amarta: tiher mikkelal shechuta, vetiher mikkelal chelev; ma keshettiher mikkelal shechuta – bithora velo bitmea, af keshettiher mikkelal chelev – bithora velo bitmea.
O kelach lederech zo: tiher mikkelal nevela, vetiher mikkelal chelev; ma keshettiher mikkelal nevela – bitmea velo bithora, af keshettiher mikkelal chelev – bitmea velo bithora!
Amrat:
b: Keshebba bederech zo – hi bithora, ucheshebba bederech zo – hi bitmea; talmud lomar: "terefa" – mi sheyyesh beminah terefa.

Otzi et hattemea – sheen beminah terefa, velo otzi et hachayya sheyyesh beminah terefa! talmud lomar: "veachol lo tochluhu" – mi shechelbah asur uvesarah muttar, yatza chayya shechelbah uvesarah muttar.
Amar leh rav yaakov bar abba lerava: ella meatta – nivlat behema tehora hu dimtammea, nivlat behema temea la metammea?! amar leh: kamma save shabbeshtu ba! sefa atan lenivlat of tame.

Amar rabbi yochanan: lo tiher rabbi meir ella bitmimin, aval bevaale mumin la. verabbi elazar amar: afillu bevaale mumin. ittemar name, amar rav bivi amar rabbi elazar: metaher haya rabbi meir bevaale mumin, vaafillu baavavzin vetarnegolin.
Bae rabbi yirmeya: araf ez, mahu?
Avavzin vetarnegolin tama may – demina deofot ninhu, aval ez lav mina deegla ninhu; o dilma mina divhema hu?
Yatev rav dimi vekaamar la leha shemata, amar leh abbaye: mikkelal deegla arufa tehora hi?! amar leh: in, amri deve rabbi yannay: kappara ketiv bah kekadashim.
Metiv rav natan avu derav huna (bar natan): "veachol lo tochluhu" – en li ella chelev sheasur baachila umuttar bahanaa; chelev shel shor hanniskal veegla arufa – minnayin?
Talmud lomar: "kol chelev".
Vei salka datach egla arufa tehora hi – hi tehora vechelbah tame?!
Hecha daaraf miraf – la itztericha leh; ki itztericha, hecha deshachta mishchat.
Vetehani leh shechita letaharah midde nevela! la tzericha, shemmeta.
Mikkelal demechayyim asura? in. amar rabbi yannay: gevul shamati veshachachti, venasvin chavrayyay lememar: yeridatah lenachal etan hi osartah.
Hadaran alach chattat haof
Mishna kol hazzevachim shennitarvu bechattaot hammetot o beshor hanniskal, afillu achat beribbo – yamutu kullan. nitarvu beshor shenneevda bo avera, o

a: Shehemit et haadam al pi ed echad o al pi habbealim, berovea venirba, bemuketze veneevad, beetnan umechir,
b: Bechilayim uvitrefa, beyotze dofen – yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyimmachru, veyavi bidme hayyafe shebbahen meoto hammin.
Nitarvu bechullin temimim – yimmachru hachullin letzorche oto hammin.
Kadashim bekadashim min bemino – ze yikrav leshem mi shehu, veze yikrav leshem mi shehu.
Kadashim bekadashim min besheeno mino – yiru ad sheyyistaavu veyimmachru, veyavi bidme yafe shebbahen mimmin ze, uvidme hayyafe shebbahen mimmin ze, veyafsid hammotar mibbeto.
Nitarvu bivchor uvemaaser – yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyeachlu kivchor uchemaaser.
Hakkol yecholin lehitarev, chutz min hachattat vehaasham.
Gemara may "afillu"?
Hachi kaamar: kol hazzevachim shennitarvu bahen chattaot hammetot o shor hanniskal, afillu echad beribbo – yamutu kullan.
Tenena chada zimna: kol haasurin legabbe mizbeach osrin bechol shehen, harovea vehannirba!
Amar rav ashe: amrita lishmateh kammeh derav shimi, veatzrichan – dei mehatam, hava amena: hane mille legavoah, aval lehedyot ema la;
Vei mehacha, hava amena: hane hu issure hanaa ninhu, aval hane ema la; tzerichi.
Delav issure hanaa ninhu – ha tena leh! mi katane bechamma?! "kol shehen" – hatam katane.
Venitne ha, vela bae ha! takkanta itztericha leh.
Dehedyot name tena leh – veellu asurin veosrin bechol shehen: yen nesech vaavoda zara!

a: Tzerichi; dei mehatam, hava amena: lehedyot, aval legavoah ema la nafsedinhu lechullehu;
Vei mehacha, hava amena: hane mille kadashim – dimis, aval chullin dela meis – ema: issure hanaa (livtele) [livtelu] berubba; tzericha.
Venivtelu berubba! vechi tema chashivi vela batli – hanicha leman deamar: "kol sheddarko limmanot" shaninu;
Ella leman deamar: "et sheddarko limmanot" shaninu, may ikka lememar? ditnan: mi shehayu lo chavile tiltan shel kile hakkerem –
b: Yiddalku. nitarvu baacherim (vaacherim baacherim) – kullan yiddalku. divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim: yaalu beechad umatayim.

Shehaya rabbi meir omer: kol sheddarko limmanot – mekaddesh. vachachamim omrim: eno mekaddesh ella shishsha devarim bilvad. rabbi akiva omer: shiva, veellu hen: egoze ferech, verimmone vadan, vechaviyyot setumot, vechilfe teradin, vekilche cheruv, vedallaat yevanit. rabbi akiva mosif: af kikkarot shel baal habbayit.
Harauy leorla – orla, harauy lechile hakkerem – kile hakkerem.
Veittemar ala, rabbi yochanan amar: "et sheddarko limmanot" shaninu, rabbi shimon ben lakish omer: "kol sheddarko limmanot" shaninu.
Hanicha leresh lakish, ella lerabbi yochanan may ikka lememar? amar rav pappa: hay tanna – tanna delitra ketziot hu, deamar:

a: Kol davar sheyyesh bo minyan – afillu bidrabbanan la batel, vechol shekken bidorayyta.
Detanya: litra ketziot shedderasah al pi iggul, veeno yodea beezo iggul derasah; al pi chavit, veeno yodea beezo chavit derasah; al pi kavvevret, veeno yodea beezo kavvevret derasah –
Rabbi meir omer, rabbi eliezer omer: roin et haelyonot keillu hen perudot, vehattachtonot maalot et haelyonot.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: im yesh mea pummin – yaalu, veim lav – happummin asurin vehashshulayim muttarin.
Rabbi yehuda omer, rabbi eliezer omer: im yesh sham mea pummin – yaalu, veim lav – happummin asurin vechulei.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: afillu yesh sham shelosha meot pummin – lo yaalu.
Derasah beiggul, veeno yodea beeze mekom beiggul derasah – o litzfonah o lidromah, divre hakkol yaalu.
Rav ashe amar: afillu tema rabbanan, baale chayyim chashivi vela batli.
Venimshoch venakrev chad minnayyhu, venema: kol defaresh – merubba paresh! nimshoch?! have leh kavua,
b: Vechol kavua kemechetza al mechetza dame! ella nichbeshinhu (denayydi) [deninayydan], venema: kol defaresh – merubba paresh!
Amar rava: hasheta daamur rabbanan la nikrav, gezera shemma yavou asara kohanim bevat achat veyakrivu.
Amar leh hahu merabbanan lerava: ella meatta, megisa asira?!
Mishshum shemma yavou asara kohanim bevat achat veyikchu. baasara kohanim bevat achat mi efshar?! ella amar rava: mishshum kavua.

Amar rava: hasheta deamri rabbanan la nakrev, i (nakrev) [makrev] – la meratztze. etiveh rav huna bar yehuda lerava: chattat shennitarva beola, veola shennitarva bechattat, afillu achat beribbo – yamutu kullan.
Bamme devarim amurim – bechohen nimlach; aval bechohen sheen nimlach, asaan lemala – mechetza kasher umechetza pasul.
Lematta – mechetza kasher umechetza pasul. achat lematta veachat lemala – (shenehen) [shetehen] pesulot, sheani omer: chattat kereva lemala veola kereva lematta.
Ella ha keman deamar baale chayyim nidchin, ha keman deamar baale chayyim enan nidchin.
Hare shechutin – dilchulle alma nidchin;

a: Utenan, rabbi eliezer omer: im karav harosh shel echad mehen – yikrevu kol harashim!
Hu deamar – kechanan hammitzri; detanya, chanan hammitzri omer: afillu dam bechos – mevi chavero umezavvevg lo.
Amar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu amar rav: tabbaat shel avoda zara shennitarva bemea tabbaot, venafla achat mehem layyam haggadol – hutteru kullan; deamrinan: hach dinfal hayeynu deissura.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: afillu achat beribbo – yamutu kullan. ammay? nema: demit – issura mit!
Amar leh: rav deamar – kerabbi eliezer; ditnan, rabbi eliezer omer: im karav harosh shel echad mehen – yikrevu kol harashim kullan.
Veha amar rabbi elazar: lo hittir rabbi eliezer ella shenayim shenayim, aval echad echad – la! amar leh: ana tarte kaamena.
Amar rav: tabbaat shel avoda zara shennitarva bemea tabbaot, ufershu arbaim lemakom echad veshishshim lemakom acher; persha achat mearbaim – enah oseret, achat mishshishshim – oseret.

May shena achat mearbaim dela – deamrinan issura berubba iteh; achat mishshishshim name – amrinan issura berubba iteh! ella im pershu arbaim kullan lemakom echad – en osrot, shishshim lemakom echad – osrot.
Ki amrita kammeh dishmuel, amar li: hannach laavoda zara – shessefekah usefek sefekah asura ad sof haolam.
Metivi: sefek avoda zara asura, usefek sefekah mutteret. ketzad? kos shel avoda zara shennafal leotzar male kosot – kullan asurin; perash echad mehen leribbo, umeribbo leribbo – muttarin!
Tannae hi; detanya, rabbi yehuda omer: rimmone vadan – osrin bechol shehu. ketzad? nafal echad mehen letoch ribbo, umeribbo leribbo – asurin.
Rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: leribbo – asurin, umeribbo lishlosha umishshelosha lemakom acher – muttar.
Shemuel deamar keman? i kerabbi yehuda – afillu bishar issurim asur! i kerabbi shimon – afillu baavoda zara name shere!
Vechi tema shane leh lerabbi shimon ben avoda zara lishar issurim; ella ha detanya: sefek avoda zara asura, usefek sefekah mutteret – manni? la rabbi yehuda vela rabbi shimon!
Leolam rabbi shimon; ushemuel savar la kerabbi yehuda bachada, ufelig aleh bachada.
Amar mar: meribbo lishlosha umishshelosha lemakom acher – muttar.
b: May shena shelosha deikka rubba? shenayim name ikka rubba! may shelosha dekatane – tarte vehu.
Veibbaet ema: savar la kerabbi eliezer.
Amar resh lakish: chavit shel teruma shennitarva bemea chaviyyot, venafla achat mehen leyam hammelach – hutteru kullan; deamrinan: hach dinfal – deissura nefal.
Veitzterich derav nachman veitzterich deresh lakish; dei midderav nachman, hava amena: hane mille avoda zara, deen lah mattirin; aval teruma deyesh lah mattirin – la.
Vei midderesh lakish, hava amena: chavit – deminnachra nefilatah; aval tabbaat, dela minnachra nefilatah – la. tzerichi.
Amar rabba: lo hittir resh lakish ella chavit, deminnachra nefilatah; aval teena – la. verav yosef amar: afillu teena, kinfilatah kach aliyyaytah.
Amar rabbi elazar: chavit shel teruma shennafla bemea chaviyyot – poteach echad mehen venotel hemenna kede dimmuah, veshote.
Yatev rav dimi vekaamar la leha shemata, amar leh rav nachman: gema usheti ka chazena hacha! ella ema: niftecha achat mehen – notel hemenna kede dimmua, veshote.

Amar rabbi oshaya: chavit shel teruma shennitarva bemea vachamishshim chaviyyot, veniftechu mea mehen – notel hemenna kede dimmuah veshote, ushear asurin ad sheyyippatchu; la amrinan issura berubba iteh.
Harovea vehannirba kulei. bishlama kullehu – la yedia; ella hay terefa hechi dame? i yaday leh – lete velishkeleh! i la yada leh – mena yada deiarav?
Amri deve rabbi yannay: hacha bemay askinan – kegon deiarav nekuvat hakkotz bidrusat hazzeev.
Resh lakish amar: [kegon] deiarav binfula. nefula name livdeka! kasavar: amda – tzericha meet leet, halcha – tzericha bedika.
Rabbi yirmeya amar: kegon deiarayv bivlad terefa – verabbi eliezer hi, deamar: velad terefa lo yikrav legabbe mizbeach.
Kullehu kerabbi yannay la amri – ben nekuvat hakkotz lidrusat hazzeev midda yedia; hay meshich vehay agil.
Keresh lakish la amri – kasavri: amda – enah tzericha meet leet, halcha – enah tzericha bedika.
Kerabbi yirmeya la amri – kerabbi eliezer la mokmi.
Kadashim bekadashim min bemino kulei. veha bae semicha!
Amar rav yosef: bekorban nashim; aval bekorban anashim – la.

a: Etiveh abbaye: korban yachid shennitarev bekorban yachid, vekorban tzibbur shennitarev bekorban tzibbur, vekorban yachid vekorban tzibbur shennitarvu ze baze – noten arba mattanot mikkol echad veechad. veim natan mattana mikkol echad – yatza, veim natan arba mikkullan – yatza.
Bamme devarim amurim – shennitarvu chayyin, aval nitarvu shechutin – noten arba mattanot mikkullan.
Veim natan mattana achat mikkullan – yatza. rabbi omer: roin et hammattana; im yesh bah kede laze uchede laze – keshera, veim lav – pesula.
Katane yachid dumeya detzibbur – ma tzibbur gavre, af yachid gavre.
Amar rava: vetisbera ha metaratzta hi?! dekatane: bamme devarim amurim – keshennitarvu chayyin, aval nitarvu shechutin – la. ma li chayyim ma li shechutin?
Ella hachi kaamar: bamme devarim amurim – shennitarvu shechutin keen chayyim, bechosot; aval bevolel – noten arba mattanot lechullan. veim natan mattana achat lechullan – yatza.
Rabbi omer: roin et hammattana; im yesh bah kede laze uchede laze – keshera, veim la – pesula. umi it leh lerabbi hay sevara?! veha tanya, amar rabbi: ledivre rabbi eliezer,
b: Hazzaa kol shehi – metaheret; hazzaa enah tzericha shiur; hazzaa mechetza kasher umechetza pasul!
Lidvarav derabbi eliezer kaamar. veibbaet ema: hazzaa lechud unetina lechud.
Nitarvu bivchor umaaser kulei. amar rame bar chama: bechor levet shammay – en maachilin leniddot; temurato mahu?
Bechor eno nifde; temurato mahu? bechor eno nishkal belitra; temurato mahu? amar rava, tanya: bechor umaaser mishshehumemu – osin temura, utemuratan keyotze bahen.
Bae rame bar chama: hitpis bechor levedek habbayit, mahu sheyyishkol belitra? ravvcha dehekdesh adif, o dilma ziluta divchor adif?
Amar rabbi yose bar zevida, ta shema: nitarvu bivchor uvemaaser – yiru ad sheyyistaavu, veyeachlu kivchor uchemaaser. lav lememra deeno nishkal belitra?
Rav huna verabbi chizkiyya talmide rabbi yirmeya amri: mi dame?! hatam shete kedushshot ushene gufin, hacha shete kedushshot veguf echad.
Matkef la rabbi yose bar avin, ma illu amar: "hafedu li bechor shehitpiso levedek habbayit" – kelum shomin lo?! "hafedu"?! rachamana amar: "lo tifde"!
Ella amar rabbi amme: kelum hikna ze – ella ma (shekkanu) [shekkanuy] lo!
Hakkol yecholin lehitarev kulei. may shena chattat veasham – dehay zachar vehay nekeva;
Chattat veola name! ikka seir nasi; hay sear vehay tzemer.

Pesach veasham name la miarav – hay ben shana vehay ben shete shanim! ikka asham nazir vaasham metzora. veibbaet ema: ikka ben shana demichaze keven shete shanim, veikka ben shetayim demichaze keven shana.
Mishna asham shennitarev bishlamim – rabbi shimon omer: shenehem yishshachatu batztzafon, veyeachlu kechamur shebbahen.
Amru lo: en meviin kadashim levet happesul.
Nitarvu chatichot bachatichot – kodshe kadashim bekadashim kallim, hanneechalin leyom echad beneechalin lishne yamim velayla – yeachlu kechamur shebbahen.
Gemara tane tanna kammeh derav: sheviit en lokchin bedameha teruma, mippene shemmemaatin baachilatah.
Amruha rabbanan kammeh (derava) [derabba]: ha dela kerabbi shimon; dei kerabbi shimon, haamar: meviin kadashim levet happesul!
Amar lehu: afillu temru rabbi shimon – hane mille deiavad, lechitchilla la. ulechitchilla la?! etiveh abbaye:

a: Vechullan rashshain kohanim leshannot baachilatan – leachlan tzeluyin shelukin umevushshalin, velatet letochan tavle chullin vetavle teruma. divre rabbi yishmael. amar leh: hannach litrumat tavlin – derabbanan.
Etiveh: en lokchin teruma bechesef maaser, mippene shemmemaet baachilatah; verabbi shimon mattir! ishtik leh.
Ki ata lekammeh derav yosef, amar leh: ammay la totveh meha – en mevashshelin yarak shel sheviit beshemen shel teruma, shello yaviu kadashim levet happesul; verabbi shimon mattir!

Amar leh abbaye: velav mi otviteh meha detavlin, veamar li: hannach litrumat tavlin derabbanan? hacha name (teruma) terumat yarak derabbanan. i hachi, ippecha mibbaya leh lemitne: yarak shel teruma beshemen shel sheviit!
Velav mi otviteh mimmatnitin demattir rabbi shimon, veamar li deiarav? hacha name deiarav.
I deiarav, may tamayyhu derabbanan? mide dehave aasham ushelamim.
Mi dame?! hatam asham – it leh takkanta biriyyay; ha – let leh takkanta biriyyay!
Ha la dame ella lachaticha shebbachatichot – kevan delet takkanta, deochel kechamur shebbahen.
Matkef la ravina: mi dame?! chaticha shebbachatichot – let la takkanta kelal; hay – it leh takkanta bischita!
Verav yosef – hechi nischot? nischot tuva – ka mafsed bishviit; nischot pureta – sof sof iarove miarav.
Etiveh rabbi shimon omer: lammochorat mevi ashamo veluggo immo, veomer: im shel metzora – hare ze ashamo veze luggo,
b: Veim lav – asham ze shel shalme nedava. veoto asham taun shechita batztzafon, umattan behonot, usemicha, unesachim, utenufat chaze vashok,
Veneechol leyom velayla! takkone gavra shane.
Hatinach asham, log may ikka lememar? deamar: log ze yehe nedava. vedilma lav metzora hu, uvae mikmatz? demikkemitz.
Vedilma metzora hu, uvae mattan sheva? deyahev.
Veha chasar leh! demayyte pureta umemalle leh; ditnan: chasar hallog ad shello yatzak – yemalleennu.
Veha bae haketara! (deaktar) [demaktar] leh.
Emat? i batar mattenot sheva – havu lehu shirayim shechasru ben kemitza lehaketara, veen maktirin et hakkometz alehen!
I kodem mattenot sheva – kol shemmimmennu laishshim, hare hu beval taktiru!
Amar rav yehuda bereh derabbi shimon ben pazzi: demassek lehu leshem etzim. detanya, rabbi eliezer omer: "lereach nichoach" i atta maale, aval atta maale

a: Leshem etzim.
Veha ikka shirayim devae (maylaynahev) [mechlinhu], veikka hach pureta dela kametz illaveh! defarek leh.
Defarek leh hecha? i gavvavy – ka meayyel chullin laazara, i abbaray – ippesil leh beyotze! leolam gavvavy; chullin mimmela havyayn.
Veha amar rabbi shimon: en mitnaddevin shemen! takkone gavra shane.
Yatev rav rechumi kammeh ravina, veyatev vekaamar mishshemeh derav huna bar tachlifa: venema, asham ze yehe asham taluy!
Shema minna: man tanna diflig aleh derabbi eliezer – rabbi shimon hu, deamar: en mitnaddevin asham taluy? amar leh: tora tora! immere bedichre michallefi lach!
Mishna evre chattat shennitarvu beevre ola – rabbi eliezer omer: yitten lemala, veroe ani et besar hachattat millemala keillu hen etzim. vachachamim omrim: teubbar tzuratan veyetzu levet hasserefa.
Gemara may tama derabbi eliezer? amar kera: "veel hammizbeach lo yaalu lereach nichoach" – lereach nichoach i atta maale, aval atta maale leshem etzim.
Verabbanan – miet rachamana "otam"; otam hu dei atta maale, aval atta maale leshem etzim. aval midde acharina – la.
Verabbi eliezer – otam hu derabbay lach kevesh kemizbeach, aval midde acharine – la.
Verabbanan – tarte shema minna.
Matnitin dela ki hay tanna – detanya, amar rabbi yehuda: lo nechleku rabbi eliezer vachachamim al evre chattat shennitarvu beevre ola – sheyyikrevu; berovea venirba – shello yikrevu.
Al ma nechleku? al evre ola temima shennitarvu beevre baalat mum, sherabbi eliezer omer: yikrevu, veroe ani lemala keillu hen etzim; vachachamim omrim: lo yikrevu.
Verabbi eliezer, may shena rovea venirba – dela chazu? baalat mum name la chaze!
b: Amar rav huna: bedukkin shebbaayin, veallibba derabbi akiva – deamar: im alu lo yerdu. emar deamar rabbi akiva – dei avad; lechattechilla mi amar?!
Amar rav pappa: hacha bemay askinan – kegon shealu al gabbe kevesh. i hachi, afillu beenayyhu!
Ella tameh derabbi eliezer: miet rachamana "mum bam" – hu delo yeratzu, ha al yede taarovet – yeratzu.
Verabbanan – "mum bam" hu delo yeratzu, ha avar mum – yeratzu. verabbi eliezer – mibbam"–"bahem", verabbanan – "bam"–"bahem" la darshi.
I hachi, "roe"?! ha rachamana achshereh! ledivrehem kaamar lehu: ledidi – rachamana achshereh; ledidchu – odo li miha, besar baalat mum – keetzim dame, midde dehave abbesar chattat!
Verabbanan – hacha meisi, hatam la meisi.

Mishna evarin beevarin baale mumin – rabbi eliezer omer: im karav rosh echad mehen – yikrevu kol harashin. keraayim shel echad mehen – yikrevu kol hakkeraayim, vachachamim omrim: afillu karvu kullam chutz meechad mehen – yetze levet hasserefa.

Gemara amar rabbi elazar: lo hichshir rabbi eliezer ella shenayim shenayim, aval echad echad – lo. metiv rabbi yirmeya, vachachamim omrim: afillu karvu kullan chutz meechad mehen – yetze levet hasserefa!
Amar lo rabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa, asbera lach: may echad – zug echad.
Mishna dam shennitarev bemayim, im yesh bo marit dam – kasher. nitarev beyayin – roin oto keillu hu mayim. nitarev bedam behema o bedam hachayya – roin oto keillu hu mayim.

a: Rabbi yehuda omer: en dam mevattel dam.
Nitarev bedam pesulin – yishshafech laamma. bedam hattamtzit – yishshafech laamma; rabbi eliezer machshir. im lo nimlach venatan – kasher.
Gemara amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lo shanu ella shennaflu mayim letoch dam, aval nafal dam letoch mayim – rishon rishon batel.
Amar rav pappa: uleinyan kissuy eno ken, lefi sheen dichuy bemitzvot.
Amar resh lakish: happiggul vehannotar vehattame shebbelalan ze baze vaachalan – patur; i efshar shello yarbe min al chavero vivattelennu.
Shema minna telat: shema minna issurin mevattelin ze et ze, ushema minna noten taam berov lav deorayyta, ushema minna hateraat safek lo shemah hateraa.
Metiv rava: asa issa min chittin umin orez – im yesh bah taam dagan, chayyevet bechalla. veaf al gav derubba orez!
Midderabbanan. i hachi, ema sefa: adam yotze bah yede chovato bappesach!
b: Ella min besheeno mino – betama, min bemino – berubba.
Uneshaer min bemino kemin besheeno mino! ditnan: nitarev beyayin – roin oto keillu hu mayim. may, lav roin oto layyayin keillu hu mayim?
Lo; roin oto laddam keillu hu mayim. i hachi, "batel" mibbee leh!
Veod, tanya rabbi yehuda omer: roin oto keillu hu yayin adom; im deha marehu – kasher,
Veim lav – pasul!
Tannae hi; detanya: deli sheyyesh bo yayin lavan o chalav vehitbilo – holchin achar harov. rabbi yehuda omer: roin oto keillu hu yayin adom; im deha marehu – kasher, veim lav – pasul.
Ureminhi: deli shehu male rukkin, vehitbilo – keillu lo taval.
Me raglayim, roin oto keillu hen mayim.
Male me chattat – ad sheyyirbu hammayim al me chattat.
Man shamat leh deit leh "roin" – rabbi yehuda; vekatane desaggi leh berubba!
Amar abbaye: la kashya;

a: Ha dideh ha derabbeh. detanya, rabbi yehuda omer mishshum rabban gamliel: en dam mevattel dam, en rok mevattel rok, veen me raglayim mevattelin me raglayim.
Rava amar: bidli shettocho tahor vegabbo tame askinan; demiddina – saggi lehu bechol dehu,
Verabbanan hu digzaru behu dilma chayes alayyhu vela mevattel leh; vechevan deikka ribbuya – la tzerich.
Amar rava: amur rabbanan betama, vaamur rabbanan berubba, vaamur rabbanan bachazuta. min besheeno mino – betama, min bemino – berubba, hecha deikka chazuta – bemare.
Ufeliga derabbi elazar, deamar rabbi elazar: keshem sheen mitzvot mevattelot zo et zo, kach en issurin mevattelin ze et ze.
Man shamat leh deamar: en mitzvot mevattelot zo et zo? hillel hi, detanya: amru alav al hillel hazzaken shehaya korchan bevat achat veochlan, mishshum shenneemar: "al matztzot umerorim yochluhu".
b: Tanu rabbanan: charsan shel zav vezava – paam rishon vesheni tame, shelishi tahor.

Bamme devarim amurim – shennatan letocho mayim; aval lo natan letocho mayim – afillu asiri tame. rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: shelishi, af al pi shello natan letocho mayim – tahor. man deshamat leh deamar: min bemino lo batel? rabbi yehuda.
Ureminhu: pishtan shettevavato nidda – mesito tahor. veim haya lach – mesito tame mishshum mashke piha. rabbi yehuda omer: af harotvo bemayim – tame mishshum mashke piha, vaafillu tuva!
Amar rav pappa: shane rok, dekarir.
Nitarev bedam happesulin, yishshafech laamma. bemay kamippalgi?
Amar rav zevid: begozrin gezera bammikdash ka mippalgi – demar savar: gozrin, umar savar: (la) [en] gozrin.
Rav pappa amar: dechulle alma gozrin;
Vehacha, bedam hattamtzit matzuy lirbot al dam hannefesh ka mippalgi – mar savar: shechiach, umar savar: la shechiach.
Bishlama lerav pappa, hayeynu dekatane: nitarev bedam happesulin – yishshafech laamma, (o) bedam hattamtzit – yishshafech laamma.
Ella lerav zevid, liarvinhu velitninhu! kashya.

Mishna dam temimim bedam baale mumin – yishshafech laamma. kos bechosot – rabbi eliezer omer: im karav kos echad, yikrevu kol hakkosot. vachachamim omrim: afillu karvu kullan chutz meechad mehen, yishshafech laamma.

Hannittanin lematta shennitarvu bannittanin lemala – rabbi eliezer omer: yitten lemala, veroe ani et hattachtonim millemalan keillu hem mayim, veyachazor veyitten lematta. vachachamim omrim: yishshafech laamma. veim lo nimlach venatan – kasher.

a: Hannittanin bemattana achat shennitarvu bannittanin bemattana achat – yinnatnu bemattana echat. (mehen) mattan arba bemattan arba – yinnatnu bemattan arba.
Mattan arba bemattana achat – rabbi eliezer omer: yinnatnu bemattan arba, rabbi yehoshua omer: yinnatnu bemattana echat.
Amar lo rabbi eliezer: hare hu over al bal tigra! amar leh rabbi yehoshua: hare hu over al bal tosif!

Amar lo rabbi eliezer: lo neemar bal tosif ella keshehu beatzmo. amar lo rabbi yehoshua: lo neemar bal tigra ella keshehu beatzmo! veod amar rabbi yehoshua: keshennatatta – avarta al bal tosif, veasita maase beyadecha. keshello natatta – avarta al bal tigra, lo asita maase beyadecha.
Gemara amar rabbi elazar: lo hichshir rabbi eliezer ella shenayim shenayim, aval echad echad – la.
Metiv rav dimi, vachachamim omrim: afillu karvu kullan chutz meechad mehen – yishshafech leamma. amar leh rabbi yaakov lerabbi yirmeya bar tachlifa, asbera lach: may echad – zug echad.
Utzericha; dei ittemar beha – beha kaamar rabbi eliezer, mishshum deitavid beh kapparato; aval beha – ema mode lehu lerabbanan.
Vei ittemar beha – beha kaamri rabbanan, aval beha ema modu lerabbi eliezer; tzericha.
Tenan hatam: tzelochit shennaflu letochah mayim kol shehu – rabbi eliezer omer: yazze shete hazzaot, vachachamim poslin.
Bishlama rabbanan – savri yesh billa, vehazzaa tzericha shiur, veen mitztarfin lehazzaot.

Ella rabbi eliezer – may kasavar? i kasavar en billa, ki mazze shete hazzaot may have? dilma tarvayyhu mayya ka mazze! ella ka savar yesh billa. i kasavar en hazzaa tzericha shiur, lema li shete hazzaot? ella kasavar hazzaa tzericha shiur. vei kasavar en mitztarfin lehazzaot, ki mazze shete hazzaot may have? vei name mitztarfin lehazzaot, mi yemar dimle leh shiura?
Amar resh lakish: leolam yesh billa, vehazzaa tzericha shiur; vehacha bemay askinan – kegon shennitarvu achat beachat.
Rava amar: leolam yesh billa, vehazzaa en tzericha shiur; ukenasa kenasu rabbanan, ki hechi dela (mishtaresh) [nishtaresh] leh.
Rav ashe amar: en billa; yazze shete hazzaot.
Metivi, rabbi omer: ledivre rabbi eliezer – hazzaa kol shehu metaheret; hazzaa en tzericha shiur; hazzaa mechetza kasher umechetza pasul.
b: Veod tanya behedya: hannittanin lemala shennitarvu bannittanin lematta – rabbi eliezer omer: yitten lemala vehattachtonim alu lo.
Vei amrat en billa, ammay alu lo? dilma kayahev elyonim lematta vehattachtonim lemala!
Hacha bemay askinan – kegon deikka rubba elyonim, veka yahev lemala shiur tachtonim veod.
Ha "tachtonim alu lo" katane! leshem shirayim.
Ta shema: natan lematta velo nimlach – rabbi eliezer omer: yachazor veyitten lemala, vehattachtonim alu lo!
Hacha name berubba elyonim, veka yahev lemala shiur tachtonim veod. veha "tachtonim alu lo" katane! leshem shirayim.
Ta shema: netanan lemala velo nimlach – ellu veellu modim sheyyachazor veyitten lematta, veellu vaellu alu lo!
Hacha name, berubba elyonim, veka yahev lemala shiur tachtonim veod.
[Veha "ellu vaellu alu lo" katane!] mi katane "ellu veellu modim"?! "ellu vaellu alu lo" katane – sefa atan lerabbanan, deamri yesh billa.

Ta shema: hannittanin bemattana achat shennitarvu bannittanin bemattana achat – yinnatnu bemattana echat. vei amrat en billa, ammay yinnatnu bemattana achat? dilma mehay kayahev umehay la kayahev! kegon shennitarvu achat beachat.
Mattan arba bemattan arba! hacha name, shennitarvu arba bearba.
Mattan arba bemattana achat!
